fields.Name: Wild Apricot

Configuration.authNote: API key used as Basic-auth username (empty password) on POST to tokenUrl with grant_type=client_credentials&scope=auto. The resulting access_token is used as Bearer token on all API calls.
Configuration.accountIdDiscovery: If AccountId is omitted from the credential configuration, issue GET /v2.3/accounts (no accountId in path) to retrieve the list of accounts accessible to the token. Use the first account Id returned as the tenant anchor for all subsequent requests under /v2.3/accounts/{accountId}/...

PaginationDefaults.note: $top values above 100 are silently clamped to 100 per spec ("If omitted or set more than 100 then maximum 100 items returned"). Use $count=true to retrieve total record count.

Configuration.APIVersionNote: Version is embedded in the path segment: /v2.3/. The credential configuration accepts an ApiVersion field (default v2.3) to allow future migration without a code change.

IncrementalSyncCapability.contactsStrategy: $filter on ProfileLastUpdated (ISO8601 date comparison) or Status change; supports async result polling via $async=true + resultId
IncrementalSyncCapability.auditLogStrategy: StartDate/EndDate query params on GET /auditLogItems (time-range window; both params required when filterObjectType+FilterObjectId not set)
IncrementalSyncCapability.defaultStrategy: full-refresh — most objects (Events, Invoices, Payments, Refunds, Tenders, MembershipLevels, MemberGroups, Bundles, Products, Orders) have no documented incremental filter parameter; sync via full page sweep

Configuration.TokenRefreshStrategy: re-issue client_credentials — Wild Apricot access tokens expire; re-request a new token using the same API key / client_credentials flow rather than using a refresh_token. The client_credentials grant does not return a refresh_token.
Configuration.WebhooksNote: Webhook delivery is not documented in the OpenAPI spec (v9.14.0) or the Admin API Help Center articles as of 2026-06-30. Webhook management endpoints are absent from the spec. Model webhook management only — do not include in sync stream.
Configuration.BulkNote: The BATCH HTTP method for combining multiple requests is mentioned in the overview article (article 182) as a historical feature but is NOT represented in the OpenAPI spec paths. No batch endpoint surfaces in v9.14.0. The connector uses per-record REST calls.

body.details: object | null — error-type-specific extra data (structure varies by error kind)

ErrorResponseShape.rateLimitDescription: Too many requests from same account. Wait for a minute and try again.

WriteCapability.create: Yes — Contacts, Events, EventRegistrationTypes, EventRegistrations, Invoices, Payments, Refunds, Tenders, ContactFields, DonationFields, Donations (no delete), Products, CeuRecords
WriteCapability.update: Yes — same objects as Create, plus most
WriteCapability.delete: Selective — Contacts (archives first, DELETE requires contact to be archived), Events, EventRegistrationTypes, EventRegistrations, Invoices, Payments, Refunds, Tenders, ContactFields, DonationFields, Products, CeuRecords, EmailDrafts. Orders and MembershipLevels/Groups/Bundles are read-only.

Configuration.ConcurrencyNote: No ETag, If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, or version field surfaces in the OpenAPI spec. The API does not expose an optimistic-concurrency mechanism. Conflict resolution must use snapshot-3-way only.

DeleteSemanticsDetail.contacts: soft — DELETE /contacts/{contactId} archives the contact (description: "Delete an archived contact"). Contacts must be in archived state before DELETE is accepted; the system uses an IsArchived / Status=Archived pattern. The $excludeArchived query param on saved-search confirms archived contacts remain in the DB.
DeleteSemanticsDetail.otherObjects: hard — DELETE on Events, EventRegistrationTypes, EventRegistrations, Invoices, Payments, Refunds, Tenders, DonationFields, Products, CeuRecords, EmailDrafts removes the record without documented archive flag.

Configuration.DefaultConflictResolutionReason: No ETag or version field documented. ConcurrencyControl=none prevents reliable MostRecent resolution. DestWins is the safe default — overwrites MJ destination with source of truth from Wild Apricot on pull.

CustomFieldMarkerPattern.fields: IsBuiltIn=false on ContactFieldDescription / EntityFieldDescription (donation fields). IsSystem=false on EntityFieldDescription. Customer-added fields have IsSystem=false and IsBuiltIn=false. System fields have IsSystem=true or IsBuiltIn=true and cannot be deleted.
CustomFieldMarkerPattern.note: Wild Apricot does not use a name-prefix pattern for custom fields. The API marks them structurally via IsSystem/IsBuiltIn boolean flags on the field definition objects.

AsyncContactsPolling.mechanism: GET /accounts/{accountId}/contacts with $async=true (default) returns ContactsAsyncResponse containing ResultId. Poll GET /accounts/{accountId}/contacts?resultId=<ResultId> until State=Complete. Use $async=false for synchronous responses (may be slower for large sets).

OutOfScopeObjectFamilies.family: Webhook delivery (near-real-time signal, not a sync stream — model webhook management only)
OutOfScopeObjectFamilies.reason: Webhook delivery endpoints are absent from the OpenAPI spec v9.14.0 and not documented in the Admin API Help Center articles as of 2026-06-30. Webhooks are a push notification mechanism, not a pull sync stream. Only webhook management (registration/deletion of webhook configurations) would be syncable if documented.

OutOfScopeObjectFamilies.family: OAuth authorization_code multi-tenant app flow (single admin connection uses API-key client_credentials)
OutOfScopeObjectFamilies.reason: The authorization_code flow is designed for multi-tenant applications where end users authenticate via their own Wild Apricot organization login page. The connector targets a single admin connection using an API key via client_credentials grant. The authorization_code flow is out of scope — it would require per-user OAuth consent screens and is not applicable to an admin data-sync integration.

Configuration.RPCOperationsNote: Wild Apricot exposes named actions via POST /rpc/{accountId}/{ActionName} (e.g. ApprovePendingMembership, CheckInEventAttendee, VoidInvoice, SendEmail). These are operations, not syncable entity families. They are out of scope for sync but may be modeled as Actions in MJ.
Configuration.ContactsAsyncNote: The Contacts list endpoint defaults to async mode. Always set $async=false for synchronous paged fetches during sync, or implement the two-step async poll (request → ResultId → poll until complete). The spec default is $async=true.

RateLimitDetail.note: Per-minute request ceilings vary by call type. otherRequestTypesPerMinute (400/min) is the ceiling that applies to Account, AttachmentData, ContactFieldDescription, EmailDraft, EmailLog, EntityFieldDescription, Event, EventRegistrationType, Feature, MembershipGroup, MembershipLevel, Product, SavedSearch, SentEmailRecipient, and Tender — none of these are the two Contacts-specific special-cased endpoints (list-contacts=40/min, contact-by-id=120/min). BatchMaxRequestCount is set to the 400/min general ceiling; the two lower Contacts-specific ceilings are documented here for connector-side throttling of those two calls specifically.
